entries.witness: Romans 1:3 "made of the seed of David according to the flesh"
entries.takes: Seed and flesh come by the woman without a man begetting [L4], for [L1] gives "her seed" with H2233 zera (seed, posterity, child) [L1][L2], and [L3] gives "made of a woman" and "made of the seed of David according to the flesh" [L3]; the chain from woman's seed to made-of-woman flesh yields Davidic flesh without requiring loins of a begetting man [L4].

entries.witness: Luke 2:48 "behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing"
entries.takes: The rows that affirm no man begetting Jesus carry the case [L4]; no verse is required to state a conclusion in its own words [L4].

entries.witness: Matthew 1:16 "And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ."
entries.takes: begat stops at husband of Mary and birth is of her, not begotten by him.

entries.witness: Luke 2:48 "behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing"
entries.takes: Thy father with G3962 pater is Mary's speech [L1][L2], but Luke's narrator qualifies sonship as "as was supposed" in Luke 3:23 [L3], so speech of custom stands beside stated qualification [L4].
